-- Independent CARD RewardItems; normal-room Prayer Wheel and Singing Bowl.
-- Generation consumes the shared card RNG in source order, never a rarity reroll.
local M={}
local function owns(run,id)return require('abyss_relic_hooks').owns(run,id)end
function M.managed(run)
 return run.rewards and run.rewards.cardRewardGroups~=nil or owns(run,'singing_bowl')or owns(run,'prayer_wheel')
end
function M.ensure(run)
 local rewards=run.rewards
 if not rewards.cardRewardGroups then
  rewards.cardRewardGroups={{cards=rewards.cards,cardUpgrades=rewards.cardUpgrades,resolved=rewards.cardResolved==true}}
 end
 return rewards.cardRewardGroups
end
function M.nextGroup(run)
 for i,group in ipairs(run.rewards.cardRewardGroups or {})do if not group.resolved then return group,i end end
end
function M.sync(run)
 local next=M.nextGroup(run)
 run.rewards.cardResolved=next==nil
 if next then run.rewards.cards,run.rewards.cardUpgrades=next.cards,next.cardUpgrades end
end
function M.prepareExtra(run)
 local extra=require('abyss_rare_relics').extraCardRewards(run,run.encounterTier=='normal')
 if extra==0 and not owns(run,'singing_bowl')then return end
 local groups=M.ensure(run)
 for _=1,extra do
  local cards,rng,offset,upgrades=require('abyss_card_pool').prepareRewards(run)
  run.cardRng,run.cardRarityOffset=rng,offset
  local group={cards=cards,cardUpgrades=upgrades,resolved=false}
  require('abyss_relic_hooks').previewCardReward(run,group,true)
  groups[#groups+1]=group
 end
 M.sync(run)
end
function M.open(run,source)
 if run.phase~='reward'or run.rewards~=source or source.cardResolved or not M.managed(run)then
  return false,'stale_card_reward'
 end
 if run.pendingBottledRelic or run.shopRelicChoice or run.pendingBossRelic or run.shopRelicRewards or run.pendingCardRewardSelection then
  return false,'relic_choice_pending'
 end
 return require('abyss_run').transaction(run,function(staged)
  M.ensure(staged)
  staged.cardRewardSelectionSerial=(staged.cardRewardSelectionSerial or 0)+1
  staged.pendingCardRewardSelection={token=staged.cardRewardSelectionSerial,rewardOwner=staged.rewards}
  return true
 end)
end
-- choice=0 is explicit API abandonment of one group; modal Skip instead uses close.
function M.claim(run,index,choice)
 return require('abyss_run').transaction(run,function(staged)
  if staged.phase~='reward'or not staged.rewards then return false,'no_pending_reward'end
  M.ensure(staged)
  if index==nil then local _,i=M.nextGroup(staged);index=i end
  if type(index)~='number'or index%1~=0 then return false,'invalid_reward_group'end
  local group=staged.rewards.cardRewardGroups[index]
  if not group or group.resolved then return false,'no_pending_reward'end
  local Run=require('abyss_run');local ok,why
  if choice=='bowl'then
   if not owns(staged,'singing_bowl')then return false,'missing_singing_bowl'end
   ok,why=Run.increaseMaxHp(staged,2)
  elseif type(choice)=='number'and choice%1==0 and choice>=0 and choice<=#group.cards then
   if choice==0 then ok=true
   else ok,why=Run.obtainCard(staged,group.cards[choice],{upgraded=group.cardUpgrades and group.cardUpgrades[choice]==true})end
  else return false,'invalid_reward_choice'end
  if not ok then return false,why end
  staged.rewards.cardRewardGroups[index].resolved=true
  M.sync(staged)
  if staged.rewards.cardResolved then staged.pendingCardRewardSelection=nil end
  return true,why
 end)
end
function M.close(run,token)
 local p=run.pendingCardRewardSelection
 if not p or p.token~=token or p.rewardOwner~=run.rewards then return false,'stale_card_reward'end
 run.pendingCardRewardSelection=nil;return true
end
return M

-- Same-run shop relic reward screens; Run wraps public commands in transactions.
local M={}
local function runApi()return require('abyss_run')end
function M.createCardReward(run)
 local owner={};for key,value in pairs(run)do owner[key]=value end
 owner.encounterTier='normal' -- ShopRoom inherits AbstractRoom's base rarity.
 local cards,rng,offset,upgrades=require('abyss_card_pool').prepareRewards(owner)
 run.cardRng,run.cardRarityOffset=rng,offset
 local reward={cards=cards,cardUpgrades=upgrades,cardResolved=false}
 require('abyss_relic_hooks').previewCardReward(run,reward,true)
 return reward
end
function M.openRewards(run,id,items)
 assert(not run.shopRelicRewards,'unresolved shop relic rewards')
 run.shopRelicRewardSerial=(run.shopRelicRewardSerial or 0)+1
 run.shopRelicRewards={token=run.shopRelicRewardSerial,relic=id,items=items}
end
function M.adapter()
 return {createCardReward=M.createCardReward,openRewards=M.openRewards,
  obtainCardCopy=function(run,uid)return runApi().obtainCardCopy(run,uid)end}
end
local function screen(run,token)
 local p=run.shopRelicRewards
 if not p or p.token~=token then return nil,'stale_shop_relic_rewards'end
 return p
end
function M.claim(run,token,index,choice)
 local p,why=screen(run,token);if not p then return false,why end
 if type(index)~='number'or index%1~=0 or not p.items[index]then return false,'invalid_reward_choice'end
 local item=p.items[index];if item.claimed then return false,'reward_already_claimed'end
 local api=runApi();local ok,detail
 if item.kind=='card'then
  local reward=item.reward
  if choice~='bowl'and (type(choice)~='number'or choice%1~=0 or choice<0 or choice>#reward.cards)then return false,'invalid_reward_choice'end
  if choice=='bowl' then
   if not require('abyss_relic_hooks').owns(run,'singing_bowl')then return false,'missing_singing_bowl'end
   ok,detail=api.increaseMaxHp(run,2)
  elseif choice==0 then ok,detail=true,'skipped'
  else ok,detail=api.obtainCard(run,reward.cards[choice],{upgraded=reward.cardUpgrades and reward.cardUpgrades[choice]==true})end
 elseif item.kind=='potion'then
  if choice==0 then ok,detail=true,'skipped'
  elseif choice==1 then
   ok,detail=api.obtainPotion(run,item.id)
   if not ok and detail=='potion_blocked_by_sozu'then ok=true end
  else return false,'invalid_reward_choice'end
 else return false,'invalid_shop_relic_reward'end
 if not ok then return false,detail end
 -- Nested permanent commands can replace the reward graph. Find the committed
 -- private owner again rather than marking the obsolete pre-command item.
 p=assert(screen(run,token));p.items[index].claimed=true;p.items[index].result=detail
 return true,detail
end
function M.finish(run,token)
 local p,why=screen(run,token);if not p then return false,why end
 for _,item in ipairs(p.items)do if not item.claimed then return false,'shop_relic_rewards_pending'end end
 run.shopRelicRewards=nil;return true
end
function M.chooseMirror(run,uid)
 return require('abyss_shop_relics').chooseMirror(run,uid,M.adapter())
end
function M.pending(run)return run.shopRelicRewards~=nil or run.shopRelicChoice~=nil end
return M

-- Permanent relic choices retain the originating room/reward behind this modal.
-- UI reads these offers and sends their owner token back; only Run mutates them.
local M={}
function M.owner(run)
 if not run then return end
 for _,key in ipairs({'pendingBottledRelic','shopRelicChoice','pendingBossRelic','shopRelicRewards','pendingCardRewardSelection'})do
  local owner=run[key]
  if owner and(key~='pendingCardRewardSelection'or run.phase=='reward'and owner.rewardOwner==run.rewards)then return owner,key end
 end
end
local function cardRows(run,owner,key,uids,rows)
 local selected={};for _,uid in ipairs(owner.selectedUids or {})do selected[uid]=true end
 local allowed={};for _,uid in ipairs(uids)do allowed[uid]=true end
 for _,card in ipairs(run.deck)do if allowed[card.uid]and not selected[card.uid]then
  rows[#rows+1]={card=card,token={owner=owner,key=key,kind='select',uid=card.uid}}
 end end
end
local function rewardCards(owner,key,cards,upgrades,rows,group,run)
 for i,id in ipairs(cards)do
  rows[#rows+1]={card={cardId=id,upgraded=upgrades and upgrades[i]==true},group=group,
   token={owner=owner,key=key,kind='card',index=group,choice=i}}
 end
 if run and require('abyss_relic_hooks').owns(run,'singing_bowl')then
  rows[#rows+1]={title=group and '第'..group..'组：增加2点生命上限'or'增加2点生命上限',
   description='放弃本组卡牌，增加2点生命上限并普通回复2点生命。',
   token={owner=owner,key=key,kind='card',index=group,choice='bowl'}}
 end
 rows[#rows+1]={title=group and '跳过第'..group..'组卡牌' or '跳过卡牌',
  description='放弃本组卡牌奖励。',token={owner=owner,key=key,kind='card',index=group,choice=0}}
end
function M.view(run)
 local owner,key=M.owner(run);if not owner then return end
 local rows={};local view={owner=owner,key=key,title='遗物效果',body='请完成遗物带来的选择。',rows=rows}
 if key=='pendingBottledRelic'then
  view.body='选择一张卡牌装入瓶中，每场战斗开始时将其放入手牌。'
  cardRows(run,owner,key,owner.uids,rows)
 elseif key=='shopRelicChoice'then
  view.body='选择一张永久牌组中的卡牌，获得它的复制。'
  cardRows(run,owner,key,owner.uids,rows)
 elseif key=='pendingBossRelic'and owner.kind=='cards'then
  view.body='还需选择'..(owner.total-#owner.selectedUids)..'张卡牌。'
  local uids={};for uid in pairs(owner.selectionUids)do uids[#uids+1]=uid end
  cardRows(run,owner,key,uids,rows)
 elseif key=='pendingBossRelic'then
  for i,item in ipairs(owner.relics or {})do if not item.claimed then
   rows[#rows+1]={relic=item.id or item.sourceId,token={owner=owner,key=key,kind='relic',choice=i}}
  end end
  if owner.gold~=nil and not owner.goldClaimed then rows[#rows+1]={title='领取'..owner.gold..'金币',description='金币加入本局库存。',token={owner=owner,key=key,kind='gold'}}end
  if owner.potion and not owner.potion.claimed then rows[#rows+1]={potion=owner.potion.id,token={owner=owner,key=key,kind='potion'}}end
  if owner.cards and not owner.cardResolved then rewardCards(owner,key,owner.cards,owner.cardUpgrades,rows,nil,run)end
  rows[#rows+1]={title='继续',description='放弃尚未领取的奖励并返回。',token={owner=owner,key=key,kind='done'}}
 elseif key=='shopRelicRewards'then
  for i,item in ipairs(owner.items)do if not item.claimed then
   if item.kind=='card'then rewardCards(owner,key,item.reward.cards,item.reward.cardUpgrades,rows,i,run)
   else
    rows[#rows+1]={potion=item.id,token={owner=owner,key=key,index=i,kind='potion',choice=1}}
    rows[#rows+1]={title='放弃第'..i..'瓶药水',description='不改变现有药水。',token={owner=owner,key=key,index=i,kind='potion',choice=0}}
   end
  end end
  if #rows==0 then rows[1]={title='继续',description='所有奖励已处理。',token={owner=owner,key=key,kind='done'}}end
 elseif key=='pendingCardRewardSelection'then
  view.title,view.body='卡牌奖励','每组奖励可以选择一张卡牌；持有颂钵时也可放弃该组卡牌，增加生命上限。'
  for i,group in ipairs(run.rewards.cardRewardGroups or {})do if not group.resolved then
   for j,id in ipairs(group.cards)do
    rows[#rows+1]={card={cardId=id,upgraded=group.cardUpgrades and group.cardUpgrades[j]==true},group=i,
     description='第'..i..'组卡牌奖励。',token={owner=owner,key=key,kind='card',index=i,choice=j}}
   end
   if require('abyss_relic_hooks').owns(run,'singing_bowl')then
    rows[#rows+1]={title='第'..i..'组：增加2点生命上限',description='放弃本组卡牌，增加2点生命上限并普通回复2点生命。',
     token={owner=owner,key=key,kind='card',index=i,choice='bowl'}}
   end
  end end
  rows[#rows+1]={title='返回奖励列表',description='保留所有尚未领取的卡牌奖励，可以稍后重新查看。',
   token={owner=owner,key=key,kind='close'}}
 end
 for _,row in ipairs(rows)do row.token.screenToken=owner.token end
 return view
end
function M.resolve(run,token)
 if type(token)~='table'or M.owner(run)~=token.owner or run[token.key]~=token.owner then return false,'stale_relic_choice'end
 local Run=require('abyss_run')
 return Run.transaction(run,function(staged)
  local p=staged[token.key]
  if token.key=='pendingBottledRelic'then
   local allowed=false;for _,uid in ipairs(p.uids)do if uid==token.uid then allowed=true end end
   if not allowed then return false,'invalid_bottle_card'end
   local ok,why=require('abyss_uncommon_relics').equipBottle(staged,p.id,token.uid)
   if ok then staged.pendingBottledRelic=nil end;return ok,why
  elseif token.key=='shopRelicChoice'then return require('abyss_relic_choices').chooseMirror(staged,token.uid)
  elseif token.key=='pendingBossRelic'then
   if p.kind=='cards'then return require('abyss_boss_relics').select(staged,token.uid)end
   return require('abyss_boss_relics').claim(staged,token.kind,token.choice)
  elseif token.key=='shopRelicRewards'then
   local Choices=require('abyss_relic_choices')
   if token.kind=='done'then return Choices.finish(staged,token.screenToken)end
   return Choices.claim(staged,token.screenToken,token.index,token.choice)
  elseif token.key=='pendingCardRewardSelection'then
   if p.rewardOwner~=staged.rewards then return false,'stale_card_reward'end
   local Cards=require('abyss_relic_card_rewards')
   if token.kind=='close'then return Cards.close(staged,token.screenToken)end
   if token.kind~='card'then return false,'invalid_card_reward'end
   return Cards.claim(staged,token.index,token.choice)
  end
  return false,'invalid_relic_choice'
 end)
end
return M
